invariants.name: 3C Field Stability Invariant
invariants.violation_action: Set field_state=degraded. Log FFT-ERR-3C-001. Trigger AA Mode escalation if aa_mode < AA2.

invariants.name: RTT12 Resolution Mandate
invariants.expression: IF lattice_node = RTT12 THEN harmonic_resolution MUST occur BEFORE any new field signal dispatch
invariants.violation_action: Block operator dispatch. Log FFT-ERR-LATTICE-001. Force op.paradox.resolve.

invariants.name: Triad Resolvability Invariant
invariants.expression: ∀ field.signal: triad(T,S,M) MUST be resolvable. Unresolvable → structural paradox.
invariants.violation_action: Raise paradox event. Advance lattice to RTT7. Log FFT-ERR-TRIAD-001.

invariants.name: Substrate Compatibility Invariant
invariants.expression: ∀ operator dispatch: operator MUST be in substrate.compatible_operators.
invariants.violation_action: Block dispatch. Log FFT-ERR-COMPAT-001. Invoke bridge protocol if available.

invariants.name: AA3 Operator Consent Invariant
invariants.expression: AA3 escalation REQUIRES operator_consent = true in session.profile.
invariants.violation_action: Block AA3 escalation. Remain at AA2. Log FFT-WARN-AA3-CONSENT-001.
